model.title: No Antisemitism in Education Act of 2026
model.meta: Judiciary Committee, Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Randy Fine (R-FL)

summary.text: The bill would require local school districts and colleges that receive federal funds to address discrimination motivated by antisemitism as seriously as they address other forms of discrimination already prohibited under Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. It would also require federal agencies, school districts, and colleges to consider a definition of antisemitism from a 2019 executive order when deciding whether a discriminatory act was motivated by antisemitic intent. That definition, drawn from the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance, describes antisemitism as a certain perception of Jews that may be expressed as hatred toward them.
